messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a coordinated base-image refresh next week focused on credentialed layer minimization and KMS key rotation. Need to lock down RBAC, audit hooks, and a canary plan. Thoughts?
kevin: +1. Can you sketch the scope? is this just our internal base or the customer-facing runtime images too? :eyes:
maria: Both. Internal runtime base (gcr/redwood/runtime-base:sha) and the smaller agent images we push to customers. Main changes: strip extra package layers, move secret-fetchers into sidecar, and switch cosign signing keys to a new KMS key.
denise: Important: RBAC for key usage must be scoped per-team. We should create a dedicated IAM role for image-signing service accounts and rotate keys + update cosign to use KMS-backed keys. Also audit log entries need to surface both key-use and image-push events.
alex: For audit logs, we can correlate Container Registry push events with KMS.Encrypt/Decrypt logs. Suggest a structured label on images: org.redwood.rebuild_id and org.redwood.builder=ci-runner so queries are stable.
tara: Agree. Also we need a fallout plan if signature verification failures happen mid-deploy. Fallback: route traffic to last-known-good variant and pause automated rollouts. Add a runbook step.
kevin: Can we do a small canary across one region first? Also, how long does key propagation take for cosign with KMS?
maria: Plan: rotate KMS key (create new key version, grant signer role to signing-SA), update CI to sign new images, publish signed manifests to staging registry, run canary in us-east-1 for 24h, then global cutover. Propagation note: IAM bindings are near-instant but some registries' cache invalidation can take a few minutes.
denise: Example IAM snippet for binding signing SA (GCP style):
```
resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/new-sign-key
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.signBlob
    members:
      - serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
denise: Also add audit sinks to forward KMS and registry logs to our central Splunk index: "sec-image-rebuild". That way triage creates a single timeline.
alex: On the image hardening side, keep the final image <120MB if possible. Minimal Dockerfile pattern we've been testing: 
```
FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc
COPY --from=build /app/bin/agent /usr/local/bin/agent
USER 1000
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/agent"]
```
alex: Remove package managers and build tools from final layers, and prefer static linking where feasible.
kevin: Any changes to KMS rotation schedule will affect other teams. Can we publish a maintenance window and a changelog?
maria: Yes — proposed window: Tue 2026-04-07 02:00-06:00 UTC. Will publish PRD and changelog. Also adding a header to registry pushes: `x-redwood-rebuild: 2412345678` so auditing is easier.
denise: For vulnerability triage: if we find a CVE after canary starts, stop the rollout, revoke canary images by marking them deprecated in the registry, and trigger emergency rebuild. Need playbook steps: triage -> backport fix -> rebuild -> resign -> redeploy.
tara: Incident response question: do we rotate keys if a signing key is suspected compromised? That would invalidate existing signatures.
denise: If compromise suspected, follow emergency key-rotate: 1) create new key, 2) sign new images, 3) update verifiers to accept both old and new for a short transition, 4) eventually revoke old key and require re-sign of old images. Add an allowlist of accepted key fingerprints in the verifier config for staged transition.
kevin: Implementation detail: verifier binary respects env var REDWOOD_TRUSTED_KEYS (comma-separated cosign key IDs). We'll update rollout to add new key first, then remove old after 48h.
maria: CI changes checklist (short):
- add KMS key id to secrets manager
- update cosign plugin to KMS mode
- sign in staging only initially
- publish metadata labels
- trigger canary deploy job
- monitor audit logs and error rates 0-1% for 24h

maria: Anyone want to volunteer to own the canary monitoring dashboard? :thumbsup:
kevin: I can own the dashboard. Will add panels: image-push rate, verifier failures, diff in IO latency, auth errors.
sec-bot: [automated] Reminder: file an RFC for RBAC changes and attach KMS key policy. Link: https://go.redwood/internal/rfc/registry-kms-2026
build-bot: [ci] staging-sign job completed for gcr/redwood/runtime-base:sha-2412345678 — cosign OK	ara: I'll run the first canary and keep pinging in #incidents if anything odd.
maria: Thanks all. I'll post the formal schedule and the runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/image-rebuild-rotation. If no objections by EOD UTC, we'll lock the window. :white_check_mark:
